SSC GD Constable in short

SSC GD Constable CBT: 80 questions in 60 minutes (General Intelligence and Reasoning 20, General Knowledge and General Awareness 20, Elementary Mathematics 20, English or Hindi 20). A right answer gets 2 marks and a wrong one loses 0.25; a skipped question costs nothing. One clock runs for the whole paper. That is about 45 seconds a question.

Pattern checked on 3 November 2026. Work out a score

80 questions × 2 marks = 160 marks. One clock for the whole paper: you can move between sections.

The CBT is followed by the physical tests (PET and PST), a medical exam and document checks.

How the scoring works

Every wrong answer takes marks away, so a skipped question can be worth more than a guess.

Say you answer 50 right and 12 wrong in the whole paper:

50 × 2 − 12 × 0.25 = 100 − 3 = 97

On average, a blind guess among four options gains about 0.31 of a mark; ruling out two options first raises that to about 0.88 of a mark.

Percentages

What is 25% of 620?

  1. 1,550
  2. 15.5

Answer: D. 155

Number series

What comes next? 6, 16, 36, 76, 156, ?

  1. 316
  2. 317
  3. 236
  4. 326
Show the answer and steps

Answer: A. 316

SSC GD questions people ask

Is there negative marking in SSC GD Constable?

Yes. 0.25 of a mark is deducted for each wrong answer, and a right answer gets 2 marks. A skipped question costs nothing.

How much time do you get per question in SSC GD Constable?

60 minutes for 80 questions: 45 seconds a question on average. One clock for the whole paper: you can move between sections.

Which sections are in SSC GD Constable?

4 sections: General Intelligence and Reasoning (20 questions), General Knowledge and General Awareness (20 questions), Elementary Mathematics (20 questions), English or Hindi (20 questions). 80 questions in all.

How can I practise SSC GD maths and reasoning every day for free?

On Takkar, each duel gives you ten new questions, five maths and five reasoning, in SSC GD marking and timing, with step-by-step solutions. It’s free in any browser at playtakkar.in/play, with no sign-up.

Is Takkar an official SSC website?

No. Takkar is an independent practice game and isn’t affiliated with any exam-conducting body. For notices, dates and results, see ssc.gov.in.
